title: Claude Code not recognize the LLM friendly markdown docs
body:
Stripe provides a lot of LLM-friendly markdown docs, however when i give he this one: https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/pkce-oauth-flow.md, he always ignore the `.md`, i must remind him the `.md` is the part of url cannot be omitted. 

Those two different version docs give Claude Code huge different, Claude Code can have much better behavior with the LLM-friendly markdown docs.

- https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/pkce-oauth-flow
- https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps/pkce-oauth-flow.md

Please improve this to respect the url, or let he know the `.md` url is much better for him.
author: Folyd
